question: Should OpenClaw accept read-scoped runtime-config drift path names and a fresh disk config snapshot read on cached health responses for this diagnostic?
rationale: The patch is additive and well-proven, but tests cannot decide the product/security boundary for auth-adjacent path visibility or the operational latency cost of per-cache-hit disk reads.

options.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
options.body: Land after exact-head checks because the diff is additive, redaction is tested, and the supplied terminal proof shows the normal read-scoped health behavior.

options.title: Request Extra Boundary Proof
options.body: Ask for a read-vs-admin transcript or a health latency sample if maintainers are not yet comfortable with path visibility or disk-read cost.

options.title: Pause For Companion Policy PR
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want the diagnostic and hot-mode restart-policy decision in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89517 reviewed as one bundle.

recommendation.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head checks because the diff is additive, redaction is tested, and the supplied terminal proof shows the normal read-scoped health behavior.
